{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the premises
print("Data shape:", df.shape)
print("Unique patient_id count:", df['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Duplicate patient_id count:", df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum())
print("Unique severity values:", df['severity'].unique())
print("Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline:", (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())

# Check the documentation's claims
assert 'severe' in df['severity'].unique(), "Severity 'severe' not found in data"
assert df['biomarker_baseline'].dtype == 'float64', "biomarker_baseline is not float64"
assert df['patient_id'].dtype == 'object', "patient_id is not object (str)"

# Check if there are any patients with 'severe' severity
severe_patients = df[df['severity'] == 'severe']
print(f"Number of patients with severe severity: {len(severe_patients)}")

# Check if there are any -999 values
print(f"Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {(df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()}")"}
